rules.rule_text: Use the canonical CI-SKU key and retain the exact source product name. Do not infer attributes from a product name.
Use the retrieved original product image. Preserve product proportions, packaging text and visible appearance.

Use the poc_approved_product_claims view for mock-approved source identity facts in POC creatives only. Benefit claims require separately evidenced real approvals. Pending and rejected candidates must not be used as claims.
Do not infer ingredient concentrations, clinical efficacy or benefits from ingredient presence.
Label generated campaign and sales data SYNTHETIC_POC. Never describe it as actual historical business performance.
Retain evidence references for product facts, claims, original images and campaign analytics in generated briefs.
These are project POC rules, not manufacturer brand guidelines. Use neutral layouts until actual brand guidelines are supplied.

notes_by_type.PRODUCT_NAME: Mock approval for exact source product identity in POC creatives only; not a benefit or manufacturer approval.
notes_by_type.BRAND: Mock pending review for standalone brand text; awaiting brand guidelines.
notes_by_type.INGREDIENT_PRESENCE: Mock rejection for creative use until ingredient wording is independently reviewed; source presence does not establish benefits.
